title: NVIDIA launches free API keys for 80+ AI models #NVIDIA #FreeAIKeys #artificialintelligence
description: NVIDIA launched free access to over 80 top AI models, including Kimi, Minimax, GLM, DeepSeek, and OpenAI, all available in one place. Users can instantly generate API keys from Build by NVIDIA and integrate them with Cloud Code, Cursor, or any AI project without any cost. This initiative lowers barriers to AI development by providing diverse, ready-to-use models, accelerating innovation across industries. It streamlines AI experimentation and deployment, enabling developers to build smarter applications more efficiently. By offering seamless API key generation and broad model selection, NVIDIA supports the democratization of AI technologies, fostering faster adoption and creativity in AI-driven solutions. #NVIDIA #BuildByNVIDIA #AIModels #FreeAIAccess #KimiAI #MinimaxAI #GLMAI #DeepSeekAI #OpenAI #AIAPI #ArtificialIntelligence #AIDevelopment #CloudCode #CursorAI #AIInnovation
